annotations.text:
Palette and type lifted from the shipped app, not reinvented:
ground #140419 / surface #210830 / line #3E1B4F
accent #2CE08C (emphasis only)
warn #F2B34E = doubt, crit #FF7089 = injured
turf #1E6B43 to #123F2A

Barlow Condensed display, IBM Plex Sans body, IBM Plex Mono for every number.

What changed from the current build:

1. The deadline is now a scoreboard block in the rail, not a caption. It is the thing you open the app for.

2. Masthead reads as a matchday programme: league position as the eyebrow, team name at 44px, stats as a scoreboard row.

3. Points-to-leader is its own stat and turns red when behind.

4. Player cards widened to 96px so long names stop truncating.
